label: Regular Half Canvas
description: Standard half canvas is the workhorse of quality tailoring: a horsehair and linen canvas running from the shoulder seam down to roughly the mid-chest, hand-padstitched through the lapels to create their characteristic rolling break. Below the canvas, the lower body is stabilised with a light fused interlining, striking a practical balance between genuine craft and production economy. The result is a jacket that drapes naturally at the chest and lapel — where 80% of the visual impression is formed — and holds a crisper, more dimensional front than any fully fused garment.
